name: session-keeper
description: Shows the prompt cache state on desktop, reads the cache once when idle so a 1h cache does not expire, and suggests handing off to a new session when the context is large

keep_warm.title: Keep the cache warm
keep_warm.description: With a 1h cache TTL and context over 30k, after idling for a while read the cache once (a fork that only replies OK) so it does not expire. Off by default; turn it on for a while with /session-keeper on keep_warm.

idle_minutes.title: Minutes of idling before keeping warm
idle_minutes.description: Minutes after the cache was last used before it is sent; must be under 60, or the cache has already expired.

max_keeps.title: Most keep-warms per idle stretch
max_keeps.description: Most keep-warms in one idle stretch; after that the cache expires as usual.

handoff_gate.title: Offer a handoff for a new task
handoff_gate.description: When context passes CLAUDE_CTX_GUARD_TOKENS (150k by default), Haiku judges whether a prompt is an unrelated new task. suggest: the prompt is sent as usual and a handoff is offered above the prompt box when it is judged new; block: the prompt is held and you choose; off: no judging (default). Turn it on for a while with /session-keeper on handoff_gate (suggest).

away_handoff.title: Offer a handoff when the cache has expired
away_handoff.description: When context is over the threshold and the cache has expired, the prompt is held and you choose to hand off or stay; with a 1h TTL the last keep-warm writes the handoff summary ahead of time instead. Off by default; turn it on for a while with /session-keeper on away_handoff.

progress_resume.title: Bring progress into a new session
progress_resume.description: The first prompt of a new session gets .claude/progress.md attached (under 24 hours old, not written by this session, not given before).
